sentences.en: Our sphere of influence has expanded so much since then.
sentences.zh: 自从那时起，我们影响力的作用范围扩大了很多。

sentences.en: Many astronomers assume that the universe continues to expand forever.
sentences.zh: 许多天文学家认为宇宙会永远膨胀下去。

sentences.en: Our primary objective is to expand the South American market.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要目标是拓展南美市场。

senses.zh: 扩大，增加，详述，扩展，使膨胀
